parameters.name: DefaultAddrPool
parameters.description: The collection of primary address pools.

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the address pool.

sub_parameters.name: LbaWeight
sub_parameters.description: The weight of the address pool.

parameters.name: DefaultAddrPoolType
parameters.description:
The type of the primary address pool.

- IPV4

- IPV6

- DOMAIN

parameters.name: DefaultLatencyOptimization
parameters.description:
The latency-based scheduling optimization for the primary address pool collection.

- OPEN: enabled

- CLOSE: disabled

parameters.name: DefaultLbaStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy for the primary address pool collection.

- ALL\_RR: returns all addresses.

- RATIO: returns addresses by weight.

parameters.name: DefaultMaxReturnAddrNum
parameters.description: The maximum number of addresses returned from the primary address pool collection.

parameters.name: DefaultMinAvailableAddrNum
parameters.description: The minimum number of active addresses in the primary address pool collection.

parameters.name: FailoverAddrPool
parameters.description: The collection of failover address pools. If a failover address pool collection is not configured, enter "EMPTY".

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the address pool.

sub_parameters.name: LbaWeight
sub_parameters.description: The weight of the address pool.

parameters.name: FailoverAddrPoolType
parameters.description:
The type of the failover address pool.

- IPV4

- IPV6

- DOMAIN

parameters.name: FailoverLatencyOptimization
parameters.description:
The latency-based scheduling optimization for the failover address pool collection.

- OPEN: enabled

- CLOSE: disabled

parameters.name: FailoverLbaStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy for the failover address pool collection.

- ALL\_RR: returns all addresses.

- RATIO: returns addresses by weight.

parameters.name: FailoverMaxReturnAddrNum
parameters.description: The maximum number of addresses returned from the failover address pool collection.

parameters.name: FailoverMinAvailableAddrNum
parameters.description: The minimum number of active addresses in the failover address pool collection.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of some returned parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: Lines
parameters.description: The source of the DNS request. For example, `["default", "drpeng"]` indicates a global policy and Dr. Peng Group.

parameters.name: StrategyMode
parameters.description:
The type of the access policy.

- GEO: a location-based access policy.

- LATENCY: a latency-based access policy.
